inlineContent.text: Add a frameworks folder into the project and add GCVCardReader.framework, NFCReader.framework and FaceTecSDK.framework into it.
Add all of these frameworks into the project as dependencies and select “Embed and sign” for both.
Add the ‘Privacy - NFC Scan Usage Description’, ‘Privacy - Camera Usage Description’, ‘ISO7816 application identifiers for NFC Tag Reader Session’ and ‘AppLicenseKey’ to the app’s info.plist file.
Add the Near Field Communication Tag Reading capability in the ‘Signing and Capabilities’ section of the app.
Import the GCVCardReader framework into the required and the public functions for OCR, NFC, Liveness Test and NProbe canb e used.

abstract.text: This article provides the list of steps that need to be followed to integrate the GCCardReader framework into an app.

GVCCardReader is a comprehensive framework designed to facilitate end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) verification for users residing in the United Arab Emirates. It supports Emirates ID capture via Near Field Communication (NFC) or Optical Character Recognition (OCR), with captured data subsequently validated through the Identity and Citizenship Authority (ICA) API. Upon successful verification, the framework conducts a liveness assessment to confirm the physical presence of the user, followed by a biometric face comparison to ensure the individual matches the Emirates ID document holder.
